gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-answer-to-a-repeat: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-answer-to-a-repeat: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-answer-to-a-repeat: Section 2.1 says an 0420 that got no acknowledgement goes again as 0421, and a repeat is answered like the original, so both get 0430.
recorded.prompt:q-shifted-but-unpacked: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shifted-but-unpacked: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shifted-but-unpacked: Section 2.2.1 says the host reads each field with the next field's definition, and its field-37 run unpacks cleanly with card digits in field 4.
recorded.prompt:q-mac-and-field-90: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mac-and-field-90: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-mac-and-field-90: Sections 2.2 and 2.3: bit 64 is the primary bitmap's last bit, a message whose last field is 64 has one bitmap, and fields 65-128 need the secondary one.
recorded.prompt:q-b64-on-a-new-link: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-b64-on-a-new-link: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-b64-on-a-new-link: Section 2.4: the 64 bits travel as 8 bytes or 16 characters, the bytes don't say which, so compare a captured bitmap with the specification first.

recorded.prompt:q-answer-to-a-repeat:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-answer-to-a-repeat:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-answer-to-a-repeat:b: Section 2.1 rules out 0431: a repeat is answered like the original, so both get 0430.
recorded.prompt:q-answer-to-a-repeat:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-answer-to-a-repeat:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-answer-to-a-repeat:c: Section 2.1 says a response adds 1 to the third digit and names 0430 as the answer to 0421, so echoing 0421 back is no answer.
recorded.prompt:q-answer-to-a-repeat:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-answer-to-a-repeat:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-answer-to-a-repeat:d: Section 2.1 reads 0430's third digit 3 as an advice response, and the 2.6 table puts request response at 1, so a reversal advice is not answered with 0410.
recorded.prompt:q-shifted-but-unpacked:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shifted-but-unpacked:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shifted-but-unpacked:b: Section 2.2.1's last line shows a shifted purchase unpacking without an error while its fields are wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-shifted-but-unpacked:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shifted-but-unpacked:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shifted-but-unpacked:c: Section 2.2.1 shows fields 3, 5 and 12 wrong as well as the amount, so nothing realigns.
recorded.prompt:q-shifted-but-unpacked:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shifted-but-unpacked:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shifted-but-unpacked:d: Section 2.2.1 shows card digits accepted as a processing code and an amount, so no per-field check caught it.
recorded.prompt:q-mac-and-field-90:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mac-and-field-90:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-mac-and-field-90:b: Section 2.3 says field 64, often the MAC, still fits the primary bitmap, so it is announced like any field.
recorded.prompt:q-mac-and-field-90:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mac-and-field-90:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-mac-and-field-90:c: Section 2.3 ties the second bitmap to field numbers 65-128, with an echo test as its example, not to reversals.
recorded.prompt:q-mac-and-field-90:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mac-and-field-90:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-mac-and-field-90:d: Sections 2.2 and 2.3 say a bit marks presence by field number; length plays no part.
recorded.prompt:q-b64-on-a-new-link:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-b64-on-a-new-link:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-b64-on-a-new-link:b: Section 2.4 says the 64 bits travel as 8 bytes or 16 hexadecimal characters, never 64 characters or 64 bytes.
recorded.prompt:q-b64-on-a-new-link:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-b64-on-a-new-link:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-b64-on-a-new-link:c: Section 2.4 shows two 1987 packagers writing the bitmap in different forms.
recorded.prompt:q-b64-on-a-new-link:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-b64-on-a-new-link:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-b64-on-a-new-link:d: Section 2.4 shows the index error coming from the bitmap at consumed=4, before any data field.
